articles.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
articles.snippet: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.

articles.title: Crypto treasury model loses its edge as stock premiums fade: DWF
articles.snippet: Most DATs now trade below the value of their crypto holdings, weakening a financing model that once helped companies expand their balance sheets.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business
articles.snippet: The action filed by state lawmakers followed a similar lawsuit against prediction markets company Kalshi in July that alleged the platform was running an illegal gambling operation.

articles.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
articles.snippet: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

articles.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
articles.snippet: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.
